[SWS_DM_01076] Clearing all configured
DDDIDs
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04246
⌈
On reception of service ’DynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier’ with subfunction 0x03 clear-
DynamicallyDefinedDataIdentifier and no dynamicallyDefinedDataIdentifier in the re-
quest, the DM shall clear all the configured
DDDIDs
.
⌋
